description: This PHP file defines a class 'TemplateBoolean' which extends 'TemplateField'. The class provides methods to generate template variables for rendering a boolean (checkbox) form field, including editing, searching, detail view, and list view, with handling of default values and existing data.

classes.name: TemplateBoolean
classes.description: A class representing a boolean form field template, providing methods to generate template variables for different contexts (edit, detail, search, list).

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Generates template variables for editing the boolean field in a form, considering current bean data and default values.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Generates template variables for searching based on the boolean field, using request data.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Generates template variables for displaying the boolean field in detail view, considering current bean data.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns the same template variables as 'get_xtpl_edit', used for list views.
